data.name: Faatihah
data.gender_notes: Faatihah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word fa'at (to open), Faatihah is a name that signifies the opener or the one who opens. In Islamic tradition, it is believed to be the name of the first Surah (chapter) of the Quran, which is a source of guidance and wisdom. The name Faatihah is thus symbolic of opening doors to knowledge, spiritual growth, and enlightenment.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes spiritual growth and opening doors to knowledge and enlightenment in Islam.
data.etymology: Faatihah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Opener, Opener of the Heavens.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Faatihah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
